direct.old: (H) An individual (other than an individual who at any time during the taxable year was the spouse, determined without regard to section 7703, of the taxpayer) who, for the taxable year of the taxpayer, has the same principal place of abode as the taxpayer and is a member of the taxpayer's household.
direct.new: Alice and Bob are married in 2018.

v1.quote: Alice and Bob are not married.

v1.meaning: Alice is not the spouse of Bob for the 2018 taxable year (spouse excluded under 152(d)(2)(H)).

v2.meaning: Alice has the same principal place of abode as Bob for the 2018 taxable year.

v3.meaning: Alice is a member of Bob's household for the 2018 taxable year.

v4.meaning: The taxable year is 2018 for the taxpayer (Bob).
